48.original: Hydaelyn─a vibrant planet blessed by the light of the Crystal.

49.original: Amid azure seas, encompassing the westernmost of the Three Great Continents,

50.original: there lies a realm embraced by gods and forged by heroes. Her name...Eorzea.

51.original: Eorzean history charts the rise of a succession of great civilizations, each enjoying an age of peace─the Astral Eras.

52.original: To date, all have proven ephemeral.

53.original: In the year 1572 of the Sixth and most recent Astral Era,

54.original: the northern empire of Garlemald amassed a great army at the heart of Eorzea, seeking dominion over all.

55.original: Rising in desperate resistance, the forces of the Eorzean Alliance met their would-be conquerors in the field.

56.original: Yet even as the battle raged, the lesser moon, Dalamud, was plucked from the heavens through imperial machination.

57.original: From its core emerged the elder primal Bahamut, who unleashed his fury upon the realm.

58.original: The devastation brought Eorzea to its knees, and the era to its end.

59.original: Yet every end marks a new beginning.

60.original: Five years have come and gone.

61.original: The light of life still shines upon Eorzea.

62.original: Man labors tirelessly to raise himself from the Calamity's ruin.

63.original: The realm is forever changed, a stranger to him once more.

64.original: Yet heedless of what lies ahead, he shall press on,

65.original: spurred by the promise of peace and prosperity.

66.original: Amid this period of great change, an adventurer arrives in Eorzea...

67.original: one whose tale is yet unwritten.

68.original: May he ever walk in the light of the Crystal.

74.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)You were moanin' in your sleep an' sweatin' buckets besides.

75.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)That'll be the aether, I reckon. Some are more prone to the sickness than others.

76.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)No need to fret, though. You'll soon get used to it.

78.original: (-Furry Creature-)Aha! You <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103> see us! I had a feeling you could, kupo!

79.original: (-Moogle-)We're moogles, and we live in this wood.

80.original: (-Moogle-)Normal folks can't see or hear us─which makes you <hex:021A020203>special<hex:021A020103>, kupo!

81.original: (-Moogle-)And seeing as how you're special, maybe you can tell us something.

82.original: (-Moogle-)The wood's been restless of late─lots of strange things happening. Have you chanced to witness anything suspicious, kupo?

83.original: (-Moogle-)But of course you haven't─you've only just arrived.

84.original: (-Moogle-)Well, there's nothing for it, then─we'll just have to keep looking. Nice to meet you, kupo!

85.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)Gridania's still a fair way off, in case you were wonderin'. Seein' as you're awake, how's about you keep me company till we get there?

86.original: (-Grizzled Passenger-)Them young'uns don't much care for conversation, see.

87.original: Bremondt's the name, an' peddlin's me trade.

88.original: As for your good self, judgin' by your unusual garments, I'd say you were one of them new adventurers. Am I warm?

89.original: I knew it! Goin' wherever the wind blows, seekin' fortune an' glory─now <hex:021A020203>that's<hex:021A020103> what I call livin'!

90.original: So long as you can avoid dyin', I mean. Ain't no secret that adventurin's a risky business─these days especially.

91.original: What was it that first attracted you to it?

92.original: Why did you become an adventurer?

97.original: ...<hex:021A020203>Power<hex:021A020103>? As in, er...power to do good? Like protectin' the weak, an' fightin' for what's right, an' all that? Aye, I thought that's what you meant. Well, adventurers do get up to a lot of fightin', that's for sure. You'll never be short of a chance to polish your warcraft in the adventurin' business.

98.original: When you arrive in town, you'd best enroll at the Adventurers' Guild─they'll set you on the right path.

99.original: An' it wouldn't hurt to join a guild, neither.

100.original: Gridania's home to a few, so if you fancy learnin' how to fight with a bow, a polearm, or even spells, you should think about seekin' one out.

101.original: Glory, eh? Well, if you're willin' to take on them tasks as other folk ain't, an adventurer such as yourself can win fame what coin can't buy.

102.original: When you arrive in town, you'll want to report to the Adventurers' Guild.

103.original: You can find out everythin' you need to know about the adventurin' business in there.

104.original: Fortune, eh? Well, it's a dream we've all had at one time or another.

105.original: Once you've learned to handle yourself in a fight, you'll want to pay a visit to whichever craftin' or gatherin' guild tickles your fancy.

106.original: Gridania's renowned for its leatherworkers an' carpenters, not to mention its botanists.

107.original: Adventurin' ain't just about killin' things, after all. A peaceful pastime may well help you make your fortune!

108.original: Well, if you ain't inclined to tell, I ain't about to pry. Might be as ol' Bremondt's a chatterbox, but he sure as hells ain't no busybody.

109.original: We all have a secret or three, don't we? Me? <hex:021A020203>Dozens<hex:021A020103>.

110.original: An' I'd rather they stayed secret, too─which is why I don't go stickin' me nose where it ain't welcome.

111.original: Just remember, though: there're more important things than fortune an' glory. Such as <hex:021A020203>breathin'<hex:021A020103>. Ain't no profit in bein' dead, an' that's a fact.

116.original: A skirmish has broken out up ahead with the Ixal! For your own safety, you must remain here until─

117.original: Bloody hells! We shall hold them here! Try to break clear!

119.original: Nice of the Ixal to send us a welcomin' party, though, eh?

120.original: Jokin' aside, this won't be the last time you meet those feathered fiends, so just you take care, all right?

121.original: By the by, is this your first trip to Gridania?

122.original: Is this your first trip to Gridania?

125.original: It is!? Well then, let this journeyed itinerant tell you the ins an' outs of your destination.

126.original: Thought not! Ah, but I'll wager there've been some changes since your last visit. Allow a journeyed itinerant to teach you a few new things about your destination. Ahem!

127.original: The city of Gridania lies slap-bang in the middle of the Black Shroud─the biggest, lushest forest in all Eorzea.

128.original: Though it ain't near as lush as it used to be, sayin' that. Not since the Calamity laid half of it to waste.

129.original: The destruction prompted a herd of new nasties to move in, an' gave the Ixal unneeded encouragement. Birdman raids've become a daily occurrence.

131.original: Behold Gridania, the forest nation blessed by the elementals!

132.original: The Black Shroud─the ancient forest close to the heart of Eorzea.

133.original: Beneath the boughs of its towering trees lies the woodland city<hex:021F0103>state of Gridania.

134.original: Once a sanctuary from the world beyond the Hedge, even the mighty elementals, eternal<hex:02100103>guardians of the forest, could not forestall the coming of the Seventh Umbral Era.

135.original: However, the goddess Nophica was never one to forsake<hex:02100103>Her children, and today She welcomes another brave soul...

136.original: one who may yet play a telling role in the tale of this great realm.

137.original: An' here's where we part ways, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF04736F6E03>.

138.original: I'm off to the markets to deliver me wares, then it's back to the highroad for me.

139.original: Here, I want you to have this─by way of thanks for keepin' me company.

140.original: Hey─you never did tell me your name, did you? Well, here's an idea...

141.original: Become the sort of storied personage I can brag about havin' met, an' I'll consider us square.

142.original: May the Matron take <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> to Her Bosom, that <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> may never want.

143.original: And in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> heart sow serenity, purity, and sanctity.

145.original: (-Wood Wailer-)Your face is not known to me. Newly come to the city, no doubt.

146.original: I am Bertennant, a Wood Wailer of Gridania.

147.original: It is my duty to protect our nation from her enemies while welcoming those who may yet prove her friends. Let us see which you are.
